_meta.description: Maps UPPCL SUPPLY_TYPE codes to their Tariff Category, per the official Tariff Categories schedule.
_meta.usage: Look up a SUPPLY_TYPE value (e.g. row.SUPPLY_TYPE from master/billed/unbilled CSVs) as a key. Codes present in live data but absent from the source PDF are listed separately under _unmapped with group 'OTHER' as a best-effort fallback — verify these against the current tariff order if precision matters.
